# Bookshelf

> Bookshelf surfaces compact, relevant book quotes during Codex, Claude Code,
> Pi, and Hermes sessions. Selection, cadence, feedback, and history stay local;
> the runtime makes no model or network calls.

## Use Bookshelf

- [Source and installation](https://github.com/Amal-David/bookshelf)
- [Project README](https://github.com/Amal-David/bookshelf#readme)
- [Agent skill](https://bookshelf-8dz.pages.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/bookshelf/SKILL.md)

## Product boundaries

- The public website is documentation for locally installed software.
- Bookshelf does not expose a hosted API, MCP server, A2A agent, authentication
  service, payment service, or commerce protocol.
- Book and quote provenance varies by record and is described in the repository.
